experienceTierBands.label: Planned or governance-only
experienceTierBands.meaning: Project is registered for governance/readiness but has no audited operator surface yet.

experienceTierBands.label: Raw legacy surface
experienceTierBands.meaning: Dashboard exists as a raw report, debug table, prototype, or ungoverned screen.

experienceTierBands.label: Adapter-aligned shell
experienceTierBands.meaning: Canonical CSS/static adapter is synced, but no surface-level component inventory is enforceable.

experienceTierBands.label: Inventoried one-shell report
experienceTierBands.meaning: One-shell route and surfaces are inventoried, but the main operator path still reads as a report.

experienceTierBands.label: Hybrid shared-component dashboard
experienceTierBands.meaning: Primary surface uses shared-kit contracts through a static or hybrid implementation, but is not fully package-native.

experienceTierBands.label: Package-native shared-component dashboard
experienceTierBands.meaning: Primary surface imports shared components directly and covers required dashboard states, but is not yet a product-grade cockpit.

experienceTierBands.label: Cockpit candidate with review gaps
experienceTierBands.meaning: Dashboard targets product-grade cockpit behavior but still has Tier 3 visual, shell, chart, proof, or interaction warnings.

experienceTierBands.label: Current static/hybrid product cockpit
experienceTierBands.meaning: Audited product-grade cockpit is current, but delivery still depends on static or hybrid adapter infrastructure.

experienceTierBands.label: Package-native product cockpit
experienceTierBands.meaning: Highest maturity: audited Tier 3 cockpit implemented directly with shared package components and complete proof/validation.
